blink.title: Blink LED
blink.description: Toggle the on-board LED on PB7 every 500 ms.

led-sequence.title: LED Sequence
led-sequence.description: Light the on-board LEDs on PB1, PB3, PB6 and PB7 one after another in a chasing pattern.

servo-smooth.title: Smooth Servo Sweep
servo-smooth.description: Sweep a hobby servo smoothly between 0, 45 and 90 degrees using a software pulse on PA1.
needsHardware: SG90 (or similar) servo, signal on PA1, powered from 5V

pwm-3ch-20khz.title: 3-Channel 20 kHz PWM
pwm-3ch-20khz.description: Set the duty cycle of three 20 kHz hardware PWM outputs (PA8, PB0, PB1) from a potentiometer on PA0, with UART telemetry and a window watchdog.
needsHardware: Optional: LEDs with resistors on PB0/PB1, oscilloscope on PA8
Optional: USB-serial adapter on PA9 (115200 baud)

oled-dht11.title: OLED Temperature and Humidity
oled-dht11.description: Show DHT11 temperature and humidity readings on a 128x64 I2C OLED display.
needsHardware: 128x64 I2C OLED (SSD1306-style), SCL on PB6, SDA on PB7

servo-potentiometer.title: Servo Control with Potentiometer
servo-potentiometer.description: Move a hobby servo on PA1 to follow a potentiometer read by the ADC on PA0, with UART telemetry.
needsHardware: SG90 (or similar) servo, signal on PA1, powered from 5V
Optional: USB-serial adapter on PA9 (115200 baud)
